scope: Explicit lightweight availability snapshot for the current research review stage; no generation, download, renewal, reservation or quality acceptance

endpoint.success: status=available, exact existing staged metadata and owned preview/fit URLs, ttl_extended=false, reservation_held=false, existing research-only closed flags
endpoint.limits: Small JSON only, client budget16KiB; existing loopback middleware, identifier validation, sanitized errors, no-store and CORS remain
endpoint.failure: SESSION_EXPIRED or STAGE_EXPIRED through existing safe error envelope; no cross-session stage disclosure, model fallback or automatic restaging

cache.semantics: New contains_current check validates a current stored ID under the existing cache lock without acquiring a value lease or touching LRU. Normal expired unpinned cleanup is allowed
cache.ttl: Publication deadline never extends on checks; exact deadline rejects even while an old lease retains expired bytes
cache.capacity: No payload copy/read, no stage lease/download slot/native task, no eviction of live entries or LRU promotion by the stage-cache check
cache.service: Validate live source/session ownership before probing its bound stage; release transient source lease before returning. A successful check is a momentary snapshot and cannot reserve later registration

client.validation: Validate input IDs and owned stage URLs, all returned five binding fields, condition, no-renew/no-reservation fields and closed flags before declaring availability
client.trigger: Explicit user button in current review area; no timer or automatic check/renew on draft import or editing
client.success: Show current availability with nonrenewing/nonreserving wording. Existing register remains an independent action and rechecks server state
client.failure: Expired stage clears current review image/files/import state; expired session clears source via original error handling. Other errors do not pretend active status
client.async: Current operation generation and exact stage/session identities govern publication; changing condition/source/stage or cancel/pagehide invalidates obsolete checks. No stale active message after reset

acceptance.backend: Fake-clock TTL/nonrenewal, no pin/copy/LRU changes, expiry during pinned retention, closed/invalid IDs; actual processor metadata path avoids decode/native work; source ownership, ASGI route and safe errors
acceptance.frontend: Strict response/binding/flags and size/error tests; installed Chrome/Edge synthetic actual UI tests for explicit GET, no POST/model/assets in check, current stage snapshot, expiry clearing and cancellation/late response isolation
acceptance.boundaries: Synthetic HTTP/UI and cache tests are not real model execution, stable-browser live-service acceptance, human approval, independent evaluation or G3
